proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D
  have key : ∀ X Y Z W : P, midpoint ℝ (midpoint ℝ X Y) (midpoint ℝ Z W) -ᵥ A =
      (4⁻¹ : ℝ) • ((X -ᵥ A) + (Y -ᵥ A) + (Z -ᵥ A) + (W -ᵥ A)) := by
    intro X Y Z W
    rw [midpoint_vsub, midpoint_vsub, midpoint_vsub, invOf_eq_inv]
    module
  constructor
  · apply vsub_left_injective A
    simp only [key]
    congr 1
    abel
  · apply vsub_left_injective A
    simp only [key]
    congr 1
    abel
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C D : P), midpoint ℝ (midpoint ℝ A B) (midpoint ℝ C D) = midpoint ℝ (midpoint ℝ A C) (midpoint ℝ B D) ∧ midpoint ℝ (midpoint ℝ A B) (midpoint ℝ C D) = midpoint ℝ (midpoint ℝ A D) (midpoint ℝ B C)
